item.title: Condemned Clinical Medical Equipment (CT Scan)
item.description: THE INDIAN COUNCIL OF MEDICAL RESEARCH (other) · BMHRC, Karond Bhopal State :Madhya Pradesh · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-07-01T11:00:00Z · score 9/10. Working 64-slice cardiac CT scan from ICMR's Bhopal Medical Research Centre, condemned as e-waste but a high-end diagnostic instrument that would cost several crores to source new.

item.title: BRASS ITEMS
item.description: Jammu & Kashmir Police (other) · As Per lot details State :Jammu and Kashmir · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-06-30T09:30:00Z · score 8/10. Nearly 100 tonnes of fired empty cases across 20 ammunition types—7.62mm NATO, 5.56mm, 9mm, .303 and others—from Central Armory Srinagar and Ammunition Workshop Jammu, sold as scrap brass at ₹1 reserve.

item.title: General Scrap Items, As Per Lot Annexure
item.description: Delhi Police (other) · Kot/Dwarka District Scecor-19 New Delhi- 110075 State :Delhi · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-06-30T09:30:00Z · score 8/10. 52,660 expended cartridges (9mm, 5.56mm INSAS, 7.62mm AK-47, .38 revolver) plus tear-gas shells and hand-grenade pins from Delhi Police surplus; military-signature scrap lot with documented quantities.

item.title: Burnt Shell 130mm with Copper Driving Band
item.description: 23 Field Ammunition Depot (other) · Suranussi,Jalandhar State :Punjab · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-07-02T11:30:00Z · score 8/10. Four thousand kilograms of fired 130mm artillery shells with intact copper driving bands, from an Army ammunition depot; distinctive military-ordnance provenance and material signature.

item.title: 650 HP Diesel Hydraulic BB,BG Locomotives and spares
item.description: Haldia Dock Complex, Kolkata Port Trust (other) · AS PER ANNEXURE State :West Bengal · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-07-09T11:30:00Z · score 8/10. Two decommissioned SAN-make 650 HP narrow-gauge locomotives from Haldia Dock Complex with original Cummins VTA-1710L engine spares, opening at nominal reserve; industrial heritage equipment from port operations.

item.title: Tatra T- 815 VTI (8X8)
item.description: 11 FIELD ORDNANCE DEPOT (other) · 11 FOD BATHINDA State :Punjab · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-07-06T11:45:00Z · score 8/10. Two ex-military Tatra T-815 VTI 8×8 trucks from an Army ordnance depot, opening at ₹1; the military provenance and vehicle type carry the story.

item.title: Burnt Bullet Scrap
item.description: Ammunition Depot Bathinda (other) · Ammunition Depot Bathinda State :Punjab · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-06-29T11:30:00Z · score 8/10. Two tonnes of burnt bullet scrap from Ammunition Depot Bathinda, sold at ₹1 reserve; military-ordnance disposal with distinctive signature.

item.title: 30- METRE SS DOORDARSHAN TV TOWER
item.description: PRASARBHARATI BROADCASTING CORPORATION OF INDIA (other) · Doordarshan TV Transmitter, Near New Auto Stand, Amini Island, Lakshadweep State :Lakshdweep · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-07-06T10:00:00Z · score 8/10. A decommissioned television transmitter tower from Amini Island, Lakshadweep, with three broadcast antennas intact; the infrastructure itself is the artifact.

item.title: Retrieving, collection &disposal of scrap of fired ammunition- DETAILS ATTACHED
item.description: SQAE(A) & LPR KHAMARIA (other) · Long Proof Range Khamariya Jabalpur State :Madhya Pradesh · Rs 1 reserve · closes 2026-07-01T11:30:00Z · score 8/10. One-year contract to retrieve and dispose of fired ammunition from a military proof-range impact zone covering five square kilometres; the scope and provenance carry inherent historical interest.
